meaning_en: Key {key} must be snake_case and carry no units (e.g. unit_cost, not cost_4_2)
meaning_zh: {key} 不是合法的设置名（只能用小写字母、数字和下划线，也不要把单位或数值写进名字）

meaning_en: No fact {key} for market {market}
meaning_zh: 市场 {market} 没有 {key} 这项设置

meaning_en: --source is required: where the value came from (e.g. owner_interview_<date>), not who typed it; history records who
meaning_zh: 需要写明来源：这个数值是从哪里来的（例如某天和老板的访谈），不是谁输入的；输入人会自动记录

meaning_en: Several markets are declared or waiting for confirmation ({markets}) — pass --market to say which
meaning_zh: 有多个市场（{markets}，含等待确认的），需要指定一个

meaning_en: {key} [{market}] changed while the person was being asked, so the confirmation no longer matches it. Nothing was written
meaning_zh: 在等待本人确认期间，{key}（{market}）被改动了，这次确认已经对不上。未写入任何内容

meaning_en: No history row #{id}
meaning_zh: 没有第 {id} 条历史记录

meaning_en: History row #{id} is {row_key} [{row_market}], not {key} [{market}]. Nothing was written
meaning_zh: 第 {id} 条历史记录属于 {row_key}（{row_market}），不是 {key}（{market}）。未写入任何内容

meaning_en: History row #{id} wrote no value, so there is nothing to go back to. Nothing was written
meaning_zh: 第 {id} 条历史记录没有写入数值，无法回退到它。未写入任何内容

meaning_en: The command is not written the way the facts verb takes it: {detail}
meaning_zh: 命令格式不对：{detail}

meaning_en: No such file: {path}
meaning_zh: 找不到文件：{path}

meaning_en: {path} is not a usable backup (a SQLite file or a SQL dump holding the human tables): {detail}
meaning_zh: {path} 不是可用的备份（应为包含人工数据表的 SQLite 文件或 SQL 导出）：{detail}

meaning_en: The database changed while the person was reading the restore from {path}; what they confirmed no longer matches. Nothing was written
meaning_zh: 在本人查看从 {path} 恢复的改动期间，数据库发生了变化，确认的内容已经对不上。未写入任何内容

meaning_en: Onboarding aborted: no answer to the last question (end of input). Nothing was written
meaning_zh: 设置已中止：最后一个问题没有收到回答（输入已结束）。未写入任何内容

meaning_en: Onboarding aborted at the keyboard. Nothing was written
meaning_zh: 设置已在键盘上中止。未写入任何内容

meaning_en: Onboarding aborted: no market given. Nothing was written
meaning_zh: 设置已中止：没有给出市场。未写入任何内容

meaning_en: Onboarding aborted: no valid market after {attempts} attempts (valid: {markets}). Nothing was written
meaning_zh: 设置已中止：试了 {attempts} 次都不是有效的市场（可用的：{markets}）。未写入任何内容

meaning_en: Onboarding aborted: no valid answer for {key} after {attempts} attempts. Nothing was written
meaning_zh: 设置已中止：{key} 试了 {attempts} 次都不是有效的回答。未写入任何内容

meaning_en: {key} is already {current} for market {market}; onboarding never overwrites it with {typed}. Nothing was written; change it deliberately with facts set
meaning_zh: 市场 {market} 的 {key} 已经是 {current}，设置向导不会把它改成 {typed}。未写入任何内容；如需修改，请用单独的修改命令

meaning_en: Recorded {key} [{market}] = {value}, pending until a person confirms it
meaning_zh: 已记录 {key}（{market}）= {value}，等待本人确认后生效

meaning_en: Changed {key} [{market}] from {old} to {new}, pending until a person confirms it
meaning_zh: 已把 {key}（{market}）从 {old} 改为 {new}，等待本人确认后生效

meaning_en: {key} [{market}] is already {value}: no change recorded (only a different source, if given, was kept)
meaning_zh: {key}（{market}）已经是 {value}，没有记录改动（如给了新的来源，只更新了来源）

meaning_en: Confirmed {key} [{market}] = {value} (the value before: {was})
meaning_zh: 已确认 {key}（{market}）= {value}（之前的值：{was}）

meaning_en: {key} [{market}] = {value} is already confirmed
meaning_zh: {key}（{market}）= {value} 已经确认过

meaning_en: {key} [{market}] = {value} is pending again; only a person's confirmation puts it back in effect
meaning_zh: {key}（{market}）= {value} 已改回待确认；只有本人再次确认后才生效

meaning_en: {key} [{market}] = {value} is already pending
meaning_zh: {key}（{market}）= {value} 本来就在等待确认

meaning_en: Rolled {key} [{market}] back from {old} to {new} (history row #{id}), pending until a person confirms it
meaning_zh: 已把 {key}（{market}）从 {old} 回退到 {new}（第 {id} 条历史记录），等待本人确认后生效

meaning_en: {key} [{market}] is already {value} (history row #{id}); nothing was written
meaning_zh: {key}（{market}）已经是 {value}（第 {id} 条历史记录的值），未写入任何内容

meaning_en: Onboarding of market {market} done: {recorded} fact(s) recorded; the market declaration is {declaration}
meaning_zh: 市场 {market} 设置完成：记录了 {recorded} 项；市场声明的状态：{declaration}

meaning_en: Nothing to restore: this database already holds everything in {path}
meaning_zh: 无需恢复：数据库里已经有 {path} 中的全部内容

meaning_en: Restored from the backup: {tables} (rows added or changed, history rows appended, per table)
meaning_zh: 已从备份恢复：{tables}（每张表新增或修改的行数，以及追加的历史记录数）

meaning_en: {key} [{market}] = {value} was confirmed by a person; {action} does not replace it with {new}. Nothing was written. To change it: unconfirm it first (recorded), or have a person confirm the new value
meaning_zh: {key}（{market}）= {value} 已由本人确认，{action} 不会把它改成 {new}。未写入任何内容。如需修改：先改回待确认（会留记录），或由本人确认新值

meaning_en: a client file cannot declare a market (market_declared [{market}]); `facts init` does
meaning_zh: 客户文件不能登记市场（market_declared [{market}]），请用 `facts init`

meaning_en: {key} [{market}] is stated twice
meaning_zh: {key} [{market}] 写了两次

meaning_en: No hub named: pass --hub DIR or set {var} (the hub's bin/hub sets it)
meaning_zh: 没有指定客户中心：请用 --hub DIR 指定，或设置 {var}（客户中心的 bin/hub 会自动设置）

meaning_en: {var}={value} is a relative path; the hub is named by an absolute one, never the current directory
meaning_zh: {var}={value} 是相对路径；客户中心必须用绝对路径指定，从不使用当前目录

meaning_en: No hub facts store at {path}: the hub has confirmed nothing yet, or {hub} is not a client hub
meaning_zh: {path} 没有客户中心的事实库：客户中心还没有确认任何事实，或 {hub} 不是客户中心

meaning_en: The hub facts store {path} cannot be read as the kit's client facts: {detail}
meaning_zh: 客户中心的事实库 {path} 无法按 kit 的客户事实读取：{detail}

meaning_en: The hub's {key} = {value} reads as {stored} here: the two definitions differ
meaning_zh: 客户中心的 {key} = {value} 在这里读成 {stored}：两边的定义不一致

meaning_en: {key} [{market}]: not copied from the hub ({reason})
meaning_zh: {key}（{market}）：没有从客户中心复制（{reason}）

meaning_en: {key} [{market}]: the hub's value did not come from its gate (last history #{history_id}: {action} by {by}); not copied
meaning_zh: {key}（{market}）：客户中心的这个值不是经过人工确认关口得来的（最后一条记录 #{history_id}：{by} 的 {action}）；没有复制

meaning_en: {key} [{market}]: the hub confirmed {value}, this skill pack confirmed {pack_value}; kept, a person chooses
meaning_zh: {key}（{market}）：客户中心确认的是 {value}，本技能包确认的是 {pack_value}；保持不变，由人来选择

meaning_en: Hub {hub}: {copied} copied, {same} the same, {conflict} conflict(s), {kept} kept, {refused} refused, {skipped} skipped
meaning_zh: 客户中心 {hub}：复制 {copied} 项，相同 {same} 项，冲突 {conflict} 项，保留 {kept} 项，拒绝 {refused} 项，跳过 {skipped} 项

meaning_en: {key} is defined differently here and at hub {hub}: {diff}; it is not copied until the two agree
meaning_zh: {key} 在这里和客户中心 {hub} 的定义不同：{diff}；两边一致之前不会复制

meaning_en: {key} [{market}]: hub {hub} is at #{hub_version}, this skill pack copied #{copied_version}
meaning_zh: {key}（{market}）：客户中心 {hub} 已到 #{hub_version}，本技能包复制的是 #{copied_version}

meaning_en: Hub {hub}: every confirmed fact this skill pack declares is copied at its current version ({checked} checked)
meaning_zh: 客户中心 {hub}：本技能包声明的每项已确认事实都已按当前版本复制（检查了 {checked} 项）

meaning_en: The hub's definitions {path} cannot be read: {detail}
meaning_zh: 客户中心的定义 {path} 无法读取：{detail}

meaning_en: {var}={value}: this skill pack keeps its own markets and copies each hub market into its own; unset {var}
meaning_zh: {var}={value}：本技能包有自己的市场，会把客户中心的每个市场复制到同名市场；请取消 {var}

meaning_en: {key} [{market}]: confirmed at the hub, never copied here
meaning_zh: {key}（{market}）：已在客户中心确认，但从未复制到这里
